One pinned run

What {{n_checks_word}} checks found in {{n_datasets}} genomic benchmark datasets

genomic-benchmarks-qc measured {{n_datasets}} datasets from {{n_collections}} collections — {{n_splits}} splits in all — and rendered {{n_reports}} reports doing it. This site is one pinned run of that tool: run {{qc_run}}, every figure drawn from the tables under data/, nothing recomputed in your browser.

Each check returns one of {{n_flags_word}} flags on one split. A flag is a statement about what the check measured, not a judgement about the dataset, and Pass is the narrowest of the {{n_flags_word}}: this check did not separate the classes. It certifies nothing about the data, and no combination of the {{n_checks_word}} flags does either.

Headline

The corpus in four numbers

  • {{n_fail}} datasets where at least one check returned Fail on the reference split {{n_warning}} returned Warning as their worst flag, {{n_pass}} returned Pass on every check
  • {{median_probe_auroc}} median AUROC reached by the strongest single sequence feature, across the {{n_probed}} datasets that were probed {{n_probe_over_0_7}} datasets reach 0.70 or more from one feature alone
  • {{n_with_any_leakage}} of the {{n_leakage_scanned}} scanned datasets have at least one sequence present in two splits {{n_leakage_over_50}} have more than half of one split present in another; {{n_leakage_complete}} have all of it
  • {{core_set_size}} datasets clear all {{n_gates_word}} Core Set gates of {{n_datasets}} measured, from {{n_curated}} curated

The checks

What each check returned

{{n_checks_cap}} checks: {{n_probe_checks_word}} probes that fit a single sequence feature against the class labels and {{n_integrity_checks_word}} that count duplicates and unique bases, plus the leakage scan across split pairs. Each bar is the {{n_datasets}} datasets, split by the flag that check returned on the reference split.

{{fig_check_bars}}

Every figure on this site opens a table of the same numbers underneath it, and no figure uses colour as its only signal. The checks page takes each of the {{n_checks_word}} in turn.

Probes

How far one feature gets

Each probe fits one feature — sequence length, GC content, a nucleotide or dinucleotide frequency — and reports the AUROC it reaches against the class labels. The figure below is the strongest probe per dataset. Read each value as a lower bound on what a model could recover from the sequences alone.

{{fig_probe_auroc}}

Leakage

Sequences that appear in two splits

The leakage scan compares every pair of splits and counts the sequences of one that are also present in the other. {{n_leakage_scanned}} datasets were scanned; {{n_leakage_unscanned_word}} was not. The bands below count datasets rather than implying a density, because the structure worth seeing is all at one end.

{{fig_leakage}}

Provenance

{{n_collections}} collections, {{n_species}} species, {{n_task_categories}} task categories. {{n_excluded}} further curated datasets were not measured, for {{n_exclusion_reasons}} recorded reasons that the methods page lists.
